units: <cite ref="Megillah 13b:12">Meg. 13ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Esther 3:1">Esth. III, 1</cite>) <he>אחר שברא … רפואה למ׳</he> after the Lord had prepared the healing of the wound (the means of salvation); a. v. fr.—<he>מַכַּת בצורת</he>, <he>מ׳ בכורות</he>, <he>מ׳ מרדות</he> &c., v. respective determinants.

<cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 3:4">Sot. III, 4</cite> <he>מכת פרושין</he> Y. ed. (Bab. a. Mish. <cite ref="M01369"><he>מַכּוֹת</he></cite>) the wound inflicted by the Pharisees, i.e. injury done under the pretext of strict adherence to the letter of the law, or of benevolence; Y. ib. 19ᵃ <he>מ׳ פ׳ זה שהוא נותן עצה וכ׳</he> ‘the plague of the Pharisees’ is he who advises heirs to evade paying alimentation to the widow. Ib. <he>זו מ׳ פ׳ נגעו בה</he> (collect. pl.) the Pharisean plague has struck her; ib. <he>זה מ׳ פ׳ נגעו בו</he> his friends under the pretext of benevolence have deprived him of the benefit of the poor-law; Y. Peah VIII, 21ᵃ bot.—

<cite ref="Sotah 10b:5">Sot. 10ᵇ</cite> (play on <he>מ̇כ̇ת̇ם̇</he>, v. <cite ref="M01339"><he>מָךְ</he></cite>) <he>שהיתה מ̇כ̇תו ת̇מ̇ה וכ׳</he> his defect was a perfection, for he was born circumcised; [Rashi: ‘the place where he was to be wounded’].—Pl. <cite ref="M01369"><he>מַכּוֹת</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 10:7">Ex. R. s. 10</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 1:2">Snh. I, 2</cite> <he>מ׳ בשלשה</he> corporal punishment (lashes, v. <cite ref="M01618"><he>מַלְקוּת</he></cite>) must be decreed by a court of three.
Ib. 10ᵃ מ׳ הראויות להשתלש a number of lashes which is divisible by three (39); a. fr.—Maccoth (Punishments), a treatise of the Mishnah, Tosefta, Talmud Babli a. Y’rushalmi, of the Order of N’zikin.
